userStories.title: Create User database model
userStories.description: Create SQLAlchemy User model in backend/src/models/user.py with fields: id (UUID primary key), email (unique string, indexed), name (string), timezone (string, default 'UTC'), created_at (datetime with timezone, default now), updated_at (datetime with timezone, auto-update).
acceptanceCriteria: All fields have proper type hints

userStories.title: Create Call database model
userStories.description: Create SQLAlchemy Call model in backend/src/models/call.py with fields: id (UUID), user_id (FK to User), status (enum: scheduled, in_progress, completed, failed), started_at (datetime nullable), ended_at (datetime nullable), created_at (datetime).
acceptanceCriteria: Foreign key relationship to User model

userStories.title: Create Transcript database model
userStories.description: Create SQLAlchemy Transcript model in backend/src/models/transcript.py with fields: id (UUID), call_id (FK to Call), speaker (enum: agent, user), content (text), timestamp_ms (integer), created_at (datetime).
acceptanceCriteria: Foreign key relationship to Call model

userStories.title: Create Alembic migration for initial schema
userStories.description: Generate and verify Alembic migration that creates users, calls, and transcripts tables with proper relationships and indexes.
acceptanceCriteria: Migration creates calls table with FK to users
Migration creates transcripts table with FK to calls
alembic upgrade head succeeds (with test DB)

userStories.title: Write unit tests for database models
userStories.description: Create pytest tests for User, Call, and Transcript models in backend/tests/test_models.py. Test model creation, relationships, and constraints.
acceptanceCriteria: Test creating a Call linked to User
Test creating Transcript entries linked to Call
